title: Quality Fertilizer
wikitext:
{{{{{1|Infobox cooking}}} |name = Quality Fertilizer |image = Quality Fertilizer.png |description = {{Description|Quality Fertilizer}} |source = [[Pierre's General Store|Pierre's]] from Year 2 • [[Crafting]] • [[Bone Mill]] • [[Mystery Box]] • [[Golden Mystery Box]] |sellprice = 10 |recipe = [[File:Farming Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Farming]] Level 9 |ingredients = {{Name|Sap|4}}[[File:Fish.png|24px|link=]] Any [[Fish]] (1) |produces = 2 Quality Fertilizer per craft |qiseasoning = false }} '''Quality Fertilizer''' is a [[Fertilizer]] that improves the chance to grow a [[Crops#Crop Quality|quality crop]]. It can be [[Crafting|crafted]], obtained from a [[Bone Mill]], or purchased for {{Price|150}} from [[Pierre's General Store]] beginning in Year 2. It may also occasionally be sold by the [[Traveling Cart]] (in any year) for {{Tprice|10}}. Thirty Quality Fertilizer are the reward for completing the {{Bundle|5000||y}}. 10-20 Quality Fertilizer may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]] or [[Golden Mystery Box]]. Quality Fertilizer must be placed on tilled soil ''before'' a seed has sprouted. Quality Fertilizer only affects the basic harvest, which means that extra crops gained at harvest (''i.e.,'' [[Coffee Bean]], [[Blueberry]], [[Cranberries]]) will be of regular quality. ==Chance for Quality Crops== {{#lsth:Fertilizer|Soil with Quality Fertilizer}} ==When to turn fish into Quality Fertilizer== Below are quick-reference tables showing when to turn fish into Quality Fertilizer, based on the quality of the fish. ''(The tables consider fish whose sell price is exactly {{Price|300}} to be '''not good''' to turn into Quality Fertilizer, since the addition of the sell price of 4 [[sap]] ({{Price|8}}) makes it technically better to purchase Quality Fertilizer.)''
